system.description:
You have multiple forms (configurations, fighting styles, etc.) that each provide their own advantages and disadvantages.

Note: Modular heroes are much more complex to create than most heroes. We strongly recommend that the first hero you create in the Sentinel Comics RPG isn't a modular hero.

Modular heroes have multiple modes that are defined during this process. First, you must choose another archetype. Either choose another option from the dice you rolled for your archetype, or reroll those dice and choose your base archetype, which then becomes "modularized." Assign powers and qualities as listed in that archetype, but skip gaining any abilities from that archetype, and instead come back to this entry to continue. If you have fewer than four powers, add one or two d6 powers of your choice until you have four powers.

Abilities

You gain the following Green ability: Switch.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.LfC0HqwPGaLkllCw]{Switch}

And the following Yellow ability: Quick Switch.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.5g3buhH23xpgaE8P]{Quick Switch}

And the following Red ability: Emergency Switch.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.afxF0llU1r8Oiel7]{Emergency Switch}

You have two Green modes, including one default mode. You may also have a free powerless mode, if it fits your concept. Write your modes on your auxiliary sheet.

Default Mode: Assign dice according to your chosen archetype. You gain no additional abilities in this mode.

Powerless Mode: Choose one of your powers from your default mode at d6, and another at d10. Gain this mode if there are circumstances where you could be separated from your power source (like having a @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.mbWy2aKC05gxmL8C]{Power Suit} that provides all your powers). While in this mode, you cannot use any abilities other than abilities from your principles.

Choose one more Green mode:

• Debilitator Mode: When you first take this mode, pick four powers from your default mode. Pick one at the same die size, one to decrease a die size (minimum d4), and two to increase a die size (maximum d12). You cannot Boost, Defend, or Overcome in this mode. You gain the Debilitator ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.cGCLce9x9Iw59zhJ]{Debilitator}

• Improvement Mode: When you first take this mode, pick four powers from your default mode. Pick two at the same die size, and two to increase one die size (maximum d12). You cannot Attack or Hinder in this mode. You have the Improvement ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.QT2BkoMwUE1JWAUO]{Improvement}

• Scout Mode: When you first take this mode, pick four powers from your default mode. Pick two at the same die size, one to decrease a die size (minimum d4), and one to increase a die size (maximum d12). You cannot Attack or Boost in this mode. You gain the Scout ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.mLYn5xKyAaj1UB6Y]{Scout}

Choose two Yellow modes from the following list:

• Analysis Mode: When you first take this mode, pick four powers from your default mode. Keep two at the same size and increase two by one die size (maximum d12). You cannot Attack or Defend while in this mode. Gain the Analysis ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.bnrMvBnbEuHepPTU]{Analysis}

• Bombardment Mode: When you first take this mode, pick three powers from your default mode. Pick two to decrease a die size (minimum d4), and set one to d12. You cannot Boost, Hinder, or Overcome in this mode. You gain the Bombardment ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.SCGKR1eC6uE8NiUh]{Bombardment}

• Regeneration Mode: When you first take this mode, pick two powers from your default mode. Keep one at the same size and increase another by two die sizes (maximum d12). You cannot Attack or Hinder in this mode. You gain the Regeneration ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.Zwgw7xpIAO3CF2Y6]{Regeneration}

• Skirmish Mode: When you first take this mode, pick four powers from your default mode. Pick one at the same size, one to decrease a die size (minimum d4), and two to increase a die size (maximum d12). You cannot Boost, Defend, or Overcome in this mode. You gain the Skirmish ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.nld1Ez33NIED3FXu]{Skirmish}

• Stalwart Mode: When you first take this mode, pick four powers from your default mode. Pick one at the same die size, two to decrease a die size (minimum d4), and one to increase two die sizes (maximum d12). You cannot Hinder or Overcome in this mode. You gain the Stalwart ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.2rktLvEHsvHGoF6d]{Stalwart}

Choose a Red mode from the following list:

• Destroyer Mode: When you first take this mode, pick three powers from your default mode. Keep two at the same size and increase another by one die size (maximum d12). You are immobile in this form and cannot Boost. You gain the Destroyer ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.8pwAJ47jFLaCKF2y]{Destroyer}

• Hunter/Killer Mode: When you first take this mode, pick two powers from your default mode. Increase each of them by one die size (maximum d12). You cannot Defend or Overcome in this mode. You gain the Hunter/Killer ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.QXGZL42zwMXgOJYV]{Hunter/Killer}

• Shield Mode: When you first take this mode, pick four powers from your default mode. Pick two at the same die size, and increase two by a die size (maximum d12). You cannot Attack in this mode. You gain the Shield ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.GRYMSfZbUtrbjIlU]{Shield}

Principle

Once you're done assigning your modes, choose a principle from your other archetype.

Roll d10, d10 for personality selection.
